data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in two listed tickers: HWBK and CBNA.

HWBK completed an acquisition or disposition of assets, disclosed in an 8-K Item 2.01 filed September 4, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/893847/000089384726000091/hwbk-20260903.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
